observations: Single upholstered chair with a curved backrest and seat.
Upholstery is a deep red or burgundy velvet fabric.
Frame is made of thin, yellow-painted metal tubing.
The backrest features a decorative row of dark-colored nailhead trim.
The chair has a modern, minimalist design with a circular base.
Watermarks 'ADETUNJI YANU' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are visible on all photos.

claims.evidence: The age of the item cannot be determined from photos.
Photos show the exterior but cannot confirm the condition of the underside or hidden joints.

claims.claim: Bought new last year, no stain, no tear, foam still firm. From a smoke free home.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The upholstery may be thin or have hidden tears in the seams.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the seat and backrest seams.

risks.risk: The metal frame may be rusted or the paint may be peeling.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the frame joints and the underside.

risks.risk: The chair may have structural instability or wobbling.
risks.proof: A video showing the chair being shaken to test for wobble.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Close-up photos of the upholstery seams to check for tears or thinning.
Close-up photos of the underside of the chair to check for rust or damage.
A video of the chair being shaken to test for wobble.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a salon chair. While the seller's condition claims are unverified, it can be priced at its worst-case value as a used piece of furniture.
